theorems.name: Submission.aetp_lusin_compact_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ), (∀ m, IsCompact (K m)) ∧ (∀ m, K m ⊆ V.carrier) ∧ (∀ m, ContinuousOn V.mult (K m)) ∧ (∀ m, (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (K m) < ⊤) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.carrier \ ⋃ m, K m) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
